memories.content: Decision: use Temporal for database provisioning workflows
Vitastor boot failure was caused by wrong media UDP timeout, fixed by raising udp_timeout_ms
Kafka cluster runs three brokers on ports 9092 to 9094
Private scratch: try custom cron before Temporal
